name: spedf_large_small_8
notes: Phase-0 standard v3 async_batch. 4 small reads (nr=8, sectors 102400-103168) + 4 large reads (nr=128, sectors 204800-217088), one 8-request batch, all extents mutually non-adjacent (gap >= 128 sectors). A LARGE is submitted FIRST: with burst budget (re-armed at first insert, bpf.c:215-216) and no deadline expiry, large_should_run is false (bpf.c:108-126), so SMALL_READ drains first, then the larges via both-smalls-empty (bpf.c:115-117). Expected ISSUE: S102400, S102656, S102912, S103168, L204800, L208896, L212992, L217088. Within-lane submission order == sector ASC -> robust to arrival ties. Large submitted first issuing 5th proves scheduler engagement.
